steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Local government: county councils, district/borough councils, and parish/community councils provide local services. Responsibilities: education (schools), social services, housing, planning permission, waste collection, local roads, libraries, and leisure centres. Funded through council tax, business rates and government grants. | Key Fact: Councillors: elected by local residents to represent their ward. They make decisions about local services, set council tax rates, and approve planning applications.
